predictions.rationale: Entry-point for the developer support module. Likely contains code that enables or disables developer-oriented functions such as debug and trace message handling.
Provides a GUI panel to inspect the central event pump; strongly associated with tracing internal events, giving developers a way to follow what happens inside ArgoUML.
Core dispatcher for application events. A natural place to emit trace/debug messages for every event moving through the system.
Handles model-level events; frequently instrumented with debug output so developers can follow low-level changes.
Concrete implementation of the model event pump (MDR). Likely generates detailed trace messages for MDR-specific events.
Alternative implementation of the event pump for the EUML back-end; expected to mirror the same debug/trace facilities.
UI component that shows status messages to the user; often the visible target for runtime trace/debug information.
Dialog that displays exceptions and stack traces, tying directly into developer-oriented debugging output.
Global AWT exception handler; captures runtime problems and is a common location for emitting trace or debug messages.
Central configuration class. Likely contains code that enables or disables specific categories of debug and trace messages via user preferences.
